# Web Awesome 3.14.0

This directory contains the unmodified Card and Button components, their transitive browser modules, and the default theme from `@awesome.me/webawesome@3.14.0`.

- Official Card: https://webawesome.com/docs/components/card/
- Official Button: https://webawesome.com/docs/components/button/
- Installation: https://webawesome.com/docs
- npm archive and original-file SHA-256 hashes: `provenance.json`
- MIT license: `LICENSE.md`

The site imports these actual custom elements as `wa-card` and `wa-button`. Library component files and visual styles have not been recreated or modified. Only the outer sidebar width and margin are set by the site. No CDN connection is required at page load.
